module turbo_decoder #(
    parameter K = 8,  // Number of decoded bits
    parameter N = 16  // Number of received bits
) (
    input wire [N-1:0] r,
    output wire [K-1:0] d
);

    wire [K-1:0] decoded_stream1, decoded_stream2;
    wire [K-1:0] interleaved_decoded;

    // Split received data
    wire [K-1:0] r1 = r[N-1:K];
    wire [K-1:0] r2 = r[K-1:0];

endmodule
